nativeBuild: cargo +stable build --release --bins; default release profile, no feature or Rust flag override
nativeBaselineProvenance: Rust workspace archived from 17a5f68a and rebuilt, not an inferred preexisting binary
performanceMeaning: Native user-CPU regression checks only. Three alternating AB/BA rounds for four workloads; fixed seven-pair C3 confirmation after its first +13.55% median. All samples retained; no speedup claim. Single-full-window extension after measured candidate affects only StopWatch and is covered by native test, not a repeat of these generic CPU measurements.
rawPrivacy: Only hashes, numeric stats, public firmware source and guest input acknowledgments retained. Raw launcher PNG/export and temporary disassemblies remain ignored; no serial text, private Flash, hostnames or personal paths retained. Original artifact hashes are not altered.

cpu.method: RUSAGE_CHILDREN user CPU delta around one subprocess; alternating AB/BA rounds

c3Confirmation.method: RUSAGE_CHILDREN user CPU delta around one subprocess; alternating AB/BA rounds

supersededLayoutPartialCpu.method: RUSAGE_CHILDREN user CPU delta around one subprocess; alternating AB/BA rounds

wasmClippy.command: cargo +stable clippy --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p esp32sim-wasm --features jit-tests -- -D warnings

wasmSmoke.command: ESP32SIM_ROM_DIR=<roms> node tools/wasm-test.mjs hello c3-hello c6-hello demo-stopwatch
